about.heading: Hi, This is Nafiz
about.lead: Hello! I am Md. Nafizur Rahman, a dedicated Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) student at the Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, University of Rajshahi, Bangladesh.
bioParagraphs: My academic journey is built upon a strong foundation in Anatomy, Histology, Physiology, Pathology, Parasitology, Microbiology, Medicine, Surgery, Epidemiology, and Public Health. I am deeply passionate about bridging the gap between biological research and advanced computational science to improve animal welfare, public health, and disease prevention.

Throughout my journey, I have integrated traditional veterinary science with modern Data Analytics, developing proficiency in Python, SQL, and data visualization tools like GeoPandas and Matplotlib to drive evidence-based research.

My research experience and focus areas include: Clinical Surveillance & Antimicrobial Stewardship evaluating veterinary prescribing patterns, owner KAP (Knowledge, Attitude, and Practices), and self-medication behaviors in companion animals in Rajshahi; Nanomedicine & Computational Biology leading a registered systematic review and meta-analysis on nanoparticle-based Rabies vaccines; and Epidemiology & Parasitology examining ectoparasite dynamics in free-roaming dogs in the Barind Tract, Cimex spp. bedbug infestation risks in university halls, and molecular characterization of Capillaria spp. in native poultry.

Beyond academics, I am an active advocate for animal welfare. I regularly participate in hands-on snake rescue operations with Save Wildlife and Nature (SWAN), Bangladesh, and dedicate time to providing free clinical services for stray and campus animals. I am eager to connect with professionals and researchers in veterinary medicine, nanomedicine, and public health under the One Health framework.

softwareProjects.name: PoultryMedix
softwareProjects.title: PoultryMedix
softwareProjects.brief: It's an AI-driven veterinary diagnostic and epidemiological platform designed for marginal poultry farmers in Bangladesh. Rooted in the "One Health" framework, it utilizes multi-modal AI to accurately diagnose poultry diseases and actively combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) by enforcing medication withdrawal periods through automated prescription scanning.
softwareProjects.description: PoultryMedix is an AI-powered veterinary healthcare ecosystem engineered specifically for marginal poultry farmers, paravets, and veterinary clinicians in Bangladesh. Rooted in the One Health framework, the platform integrates real-time symptom diagnosis with deep-learning vision models, antimicrobial resistance (AMR) mitigation surveillance, automated veterinary prescription scanning, disease outbreak mapping across regional farming clusters, and structured tele-consultation channels.
features: Multi-Modal AI Symptom & Lesion Diagnostic Engine for rapid poultry disease triage
AMR Mitigation & Drug Withdrawal Tracker with automated prescription optical analysis
Outbreak Geo-Mapping & Epidemiological Hotspot Surveillance across regional poultry farms
Bilingual Clinical Consultation & Paravet Advisory Hub with audio & image support
Integrated Consultation Records, Vaccination Schedules, and Biosecurity Checklists

softwareProjects.name: ZunSync
softwareProjects.title: ZunSync
softwareProjects.brief: An evidence-grounded computational research workbench engineered for veterinary epidemiologists, One Health scientists, and molecular researchers, featuring end-to-end data provenance tracking, literature synthesis pipelines, and Dockerized reproducibility.
softwareProjects.description: ZunSync is a specialized computational platform developed to harmonize veterinary field surveillance data with molecular genetics and biomedical informatics. It bridges the gap between field epidemiology and laboratory bioinformatics by offering structured pipelines for PRISMA-compliant meta-analyses, sequence annotation workflows, automated statistical modeling in R/Python, and reproducible Docker containerization.
features: Literature Screening & Systematic Extraction Pipeline for PRISMA-compliant meta-analyses
Genomic & Parasitological Sequence Data Harmonization (COX1, 18S rRNA, phylogenetic trees)
Statistical Pipeline Automation: Random-effects modeling, forest plots, and funnel plot analysis
Real-time Data Provenance Audit Trail with Git-backed versioning and DOI integration
Full Docker Compose deployment environment for guaranteed cross-platform reproducibility

projects.name: PoultryMedix
projects.title: PoultryMedix
projects.brief: It's an AI-driven veterinary diagnostic and epidemiological platform designed for marginal poultry farmers in Bangladesh. Rooted in the "One Health" framework, it utilizes multi-modal AI to accurately diagnose poultry diseases and actively combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) by enforcing medication withdrawal periods through automated prescription scanning.
projects.description: PoultryMedix is an AI-powered veterinary healthcare ecosystem engineered specifically for marginal poultry farmers, paravets, and veterinary clinicians in Bangladesh. Rooted in the One Health framework, the platform integrates real-time symptom diagnosis with deep-learning vision models, antimicrobial resistance (AMR) mitigation surveillance, automated veterinary prescription scanning, disease outbreak mapping across regional farming clusters, and structured tele-consultation channels.
features: Multi-Modal AI Symptom & Lesion Diagnostic Engine for rapid poultry disease triage
AMR Mitigation & Drug Withdrawal Tracker with automated prescription optical analysis
Outbreak Geo-Mapping & Epidemiological Hotspot Surveillance across regional poultry farms
Bilingual Clinical Consultation & Paravet Advisory Hub with audio & image support
Integrated Consultation Records, Vaccination Schedules, and Biosecurity Checklists

projects.name: ZunSync
projects.title: ZunSync
projects.brief: An evidence-grounded computational research workbench engineered for veterinary epidemiologists, One Health scientists, and molecular researchers, featuring end-to-end data provenance tracking, literature synthesis pipelines, and Dockerized reproducibility.
projects.description: ZunSync is a specialized computational platform developed to harmonize veterinary field surveillance data with molecular genetics and biomedical informatics. It bridges the gap between field epidemiology and laboratory bioinformatics by offering structured pipelines for PRISMA-compliant meta-analyses, sequence annotation workflows, automated statistical modeling in R/Python, and reproducible Docker containerization.
features: Literature Screening & Systematic Extraction Pipeline for PRISMA-compliant meta-analyses
Genomic & Parasitological Sequence Data Harmonization (COX1, 18S rRNA, phylogenetic trees)
Statistical Pipeline Automation: Random-effects modeling, forest plots, and funnel plot analysis
Real-time Data Provenance Audit Trail with Git-backed versioning and DOI integration
Full Docker Compose deployment environment for guaranteed cross-platform reproducibility
